description: Delete a tab by tabId (cascades to child tabs). expectTitle (the tab’s title from list_tabs) is REQUIRED — it is shown in the confirmation and verified against the live tab, so an opaque/stale tabId cannot silently delete the wrong tab.

account.description: Google account email to use. Defaults to GDOCS_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, or the sole account.

expectTitle.description: the tab’s title (from list_tabs); verified before deleting

name: delete_tab
title: Delete a tab
